name: As a returning user, when I log in with an expired password, I want to be able to reset it and regain access to my account
acceptance_criteria: An expired password must trigger the reset flow instead of a hard login failure
The reset email must be sent within 5 seconds of the request
The new password must meet the configured complexity rules
After reset, the user is signed in without re-entering credentials
implementation_rules: Do not store passwords in plain text
Reuse the existing email service for the reset link
Add integration tests for the expired-password path
current_status: The login endpoint exists at POST /api/login and uses bcrypt for password verification. There is no password-reset flow yet.
extra_details: Reset tokens should expire after 15 minutes and be single-use. Make sure you understand the codebase before implementing the changes or making assumptions.
